column1: # cases.tsv - six TAB-separated fields: id, expect, group, page, names, note
#   expect  finding = the classifier must report at least one finding on this page
#   group   which assertion the case is counted under: spelling, unreadable,
#           forbidden, clean, folded. A group with no case in it is exit 2,
#   names   the capability names the classifier must resolve on this page,
#           separated by ';', or the word `none` for "it must resolve no name".
#           This field is what tells a request that was FOLDED to its name from
#           one that was merely flagged as unreadable - and `none` is the
#           assertion that the check never invents a name it did not read.
#   note    why the case exists. Not parsed.
